## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List the relevant offline checks. Identify any live inference separately, including
its approved scope, model revisions and actual token use.

## Research and data integrity

- [ ] Claims distinguish measured findings, uncertainty and unassessed dimensions.
- [ ] Original experiment artifacts and their checksums remain intact.
- [ ] No credentials, private records, model weights, caches or temporary files are included.
- [ ] Documentation reflects any scoring, protocol or behavior changes.
